normalized_output:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
NUMBER d = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[3]).
NUMBER[] values=[a,b,c,d].
NUMBER left=4.
NUMBER right=0.
LOOP (NUMBER i=0 TILL i<4, i++) { IF (values[i]<0) { left=i. } }
LOOP (NUMBER i=left+1 TILL i<4, i++) { IF (values[i]%2==0) { right+=1. } }
DISPLAYNL(left+right).
